method: Read-only Defender performance recording; protection and exclusions unchanged
redaction: Only repository file paths and selected background signature-check image names retained; other file paths omitted.
units: Raw time/duration values are 100-nanosecond ticks; scan durations can overlap and are not CPU time.
interpretation: Long reported scan durations ending at the recording boundary do not match the observed file-operation durations. The recording establishes scan activity, not a synchronous filesystem block or unique timeout cause.
